- Liability & indemnities: redlines in the order form around data-scope; CardioTech is asking for carveouts for regulated PHI derived from our inputs.

We can be flexible but need written confirmation on SCCs/TIA approach and whether you can provide an evidence binder (SOC2 + subprocessor attestations + KMS architecture diagram) by EOW.
